sentences.text: He further submits that appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.

The 2 CRA-2695-2022 allegation of rape is against the present appellant but it has not been proved in the medical report.
He further submits that the trial Court has convicted the appellant on the basis of surmises and conjectures.
There are material contradictions and omissions in the testimonies of the prosecution witnesses.
The appellant is in jail since 06.02.2021.
This appeal is of the year 2022 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal in near future.

Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed.
